name: FDC Limited
summary: FDC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades in pharmaceutical products in India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical formulations for various therapeutic segments, including anti-infectives, gastroenterology, ophthalmology, anti-diabetics, cardiovascular care, respiratory care, gynaecology, dermatology, paediatrics, analgesics, vitamins, and nutritional health in the form of tablets, capsules, oral liquids, ophthalmic drops, topical preparations, and paediatric-friendly solutions.
